target_customer: Early stage and growth companies in defense, healthcare, GovTech and other sectors that need lobbying, regulatory monitoring and government sales help
problem: Companies need to influence policymakers and win government contracts, but traditional firms split Hill, agency and procurement work across expensive separate teams. Locke pairs in-house lobbyists with an AI system (LockeOS).
business_model: Professional services firm (retainers) powered by proprietary AI software
product_category: AI-native government affairs and lobbying firm

founders.name: Parth Badhwar
education: BA Political Science, George Washington University
founders.background_notes: Launch post says he also led go to market at an unnamed startup selling to dozens of government offices.

competitors.name: Fed10
competitors.what: Legislative consulting firm where AI agents deliver government affairs services (YC W26)

competitors.name: Helios
competitors.what: AI operating system for public policy and regulatory teams (Proxi)

competitors.name: Quorum
competitors.traction_then: Received strategic investment from Enlightenment Capital; date not confirmed in snippet

technical_complexity.rationale: The core is a service business with AI tooling for monitoring and drafting; the hard part is political access and talent rather than engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Relationships with policymakers and experienced lobbyists matter, but a services firm is replicable by incumbents adopting AI.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: K Street firms were reported to be increasing AI related work in 2026, and several AI native policy startups existed; no direct takeover found.

market_need_then: Reported AI related lobbying spending rose in 2026, and companies sell to government at growing scale; company reports over 500K USD run rate six weeks after launch (its own statement).

branding.domain_note: Uses locke.inc; corporate entity shown as Justinian AI, Inc. on the site footer

identity.visual_style: Institutional: logos of the White House, Senate, Pentagon and NASA, with historical public private examples
identity.voice_and_tone: Serious and mission driven, public private collaboration theme

branding.brand_signature: Public private collaboration narrative (Apollo, Manhattan Project, CHIPS Act) and the Locke name
branding.community_and_virality: Forbes article on YC startups dated 2026-09-03 linked from the site; Runtimewire covered the launch

brand_strength.rationale: Serious, credible institutional framing and some press pickup, but the name is shared with a law firm and other products and the brand is weeks old.

outcome_analysis: Locke is a Summer 2026 company with no outcome yet. The founder's White House and policy background and a reported 500K USD run rate within weeks (company statement) support founder market fit. Risks are the services heavy model, regulation of lobbying work and competing AI native policy startups such as Fed10.
notes: Site says it is backed by Y Combinator, Paul Graham and other investors but gives no amounts or rounds. Dealroom lists a 125k USD seed shared identically with a Justinian entry, unverified. Revenue run rate is a company claim. Competitor Quorum source date not confirmed.
